title: yellowstone molten irish pecan nuts stew
description: a rich and creamy stew originating from the american west, blending irish flavors with a twist of molten pecan nuts. perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large dutch oven over medium heat.
add the chopped bacon and cook until crispy, then remove from the pot.
add the diced onion, carrots, and celery and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
add the chopped smoked salmon, potatoes, garlic, thyme, and bay leaves to the pot.
pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes.
add the heavy cream, dijon mustard, and toasted pecan nuts to the pot.
stir in the crispy bacon and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
season with salt and black pepper to taste.
serve hot, garnished with additional thyme and pecan nuts if desired.
